column1:
When and why do you use the
Futuro compuesto?
column2:
• Completion by a future point — para mayo habré terminado. The literal meaning, and the rarer one.
  • Conjecture about the recent past — habrá salido = 'he must have left'. How you will actually meet it.

column1:
Tricks and tips for the
Futuro compuesto
column2:
• Everything the simple future does for present conjecture, this does for past conjecture. Estará cansado = he's probably tired; habrá dormido mal = he must have slept badly.
  • Compositional — no new forms to learn.
